text:
jamie: Quick Q — where's the saved logsearch for cross-region 5xx by org+model+route? I need it for the oncall deck.
lee: I created one a while back, it's under Saved Searches > 'ops:5xx-by-org-model-route'. Link: https://log.redwood.ai/saved/ops-5xx-by-org-model-route
santiago: If you want a compact query you can paste:
```
service:inference AND org:\"acme\" AND route:\"gen\" AND model:\"redwood-3b\" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| stats count() by region, model, route
| sort -count()
```
jamie: perfect — can you paste the exact query text (so I can pin to the deck) and a latency version (p95) too?
santiago: sure. latency (logs-based) version:
```
service:inference AND org:\"acme\" AND route:\"gen\" AND model:\"redwood-3b\"
| parse \"latency_ms=\" as latency_ms
| stats pct(95, to_number(latency_ms)) as p95_latency by region, model, route
| where p95_latency > 1000
```
maria: fyi — alert 'ops-5xx-rate' has been noisy. Current threshold = 5% over 5m. For gen-route in eu we agreed to relax during the canary.
lee: I can add route scope to the alert. do we want to restrict to org:acme only or include others?
jamie: acme only for the deck. Also create a saved filter that combines 5xx + p95>1000 so we can pivot quickly.
santiago: example combined saved search you can import:
```
service:inference AND org:\"acme\" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| parse \"latency_ms=\" as latency_ms
| stats count() as errors, pct(95, to_number(latency_ms)) as p95_latency by region, model, route
| where errors > 10 AND p95_latency > 1000
| sort -errors
```
lee: I'll create the saved search named 'ops:acme-5xx-p95>1s' and pin it to the SRE dashboard. Adding alert scope now.
ops-bot: deployment job #6721 finished — canary rolled to 10% in eu-west-1 :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — once lee updates alert thresholds i'll annotate the incident runbook for oncall.
jamie: thanks everyone. @lee ping me when the saved search and alert changes are live, I'll include screenshot in the deck. :thumbsup:
lee: will do, ETA ~30m.
